objections.text: The supplied arithmetic is 3 * 0.95 * 0.505 / 100 = 0.0143925, not 0.01438875. It rounds and truncates to the same two-decimal value, 0.01, so this input does not test the claimed rounding tie or the planted round-versus-truncation defect.

DeliveryAddressLine2 is NULL, so the entire address expression is NULL whether DeliveryAddressLine1 is '' or NULL. The fixed two-order case already tests NULL line 2. A03 cannot expose a conversion that collapses the supplied empty line 1 to NULL.

The hand-derived 'an order without lines' case has the same requested order, empty Sales.OrderLines table and expected NOT NULL failure with rollback. A06 does not change any input that reaches a different path.
